title: 3DMark Benchmark Automation Tool
description: Python Script to Automate Testing GPU overclocks/undervolts via 3DMark TimeSpy Extreme. Makes use of PyAutoGUI and ElementTree XML API to help the automation process.

title: Student Portal Oracle SQL Database Project
description: Oracle SQL database project within the Oracle APEX environment. Created with 2 other students. The goal was to create a version of the university's student portal system.

title: Wordle: Python Terminal Edition
description: Wordle but within the Python terminal. Pulls 5-letter words from https://eslforums.com/5-letter-words/

title: Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Application (Linux)
description: Developed a Linux-based Peer-to-Peer application in C with a classmate, utilizing an index server for content registration and address resolution, and a peer-to-peer network for demonstrating proficiency in decentralized communication and resource sharing.

title: General Purpose CPU (RISC)
description: Developed and implemented a RISC CPU in VHDL, integrating a control unit, data-path, and reset circuit using Altera Quartus II. Conducted timing simulations and testing to validate CPU operations.

title: Java Bookstore Application
description: Developed a bookstore application with a team of four using JavaFX for the GUI, incorporating the State Design Pattern for a reward point system and the Singleton Design Pattern to manage book and customer databases.

title: Cache Controller Project
description: Developed a cache controller in VHDL on the Spartan-3E FPGA, optimizing data transfer between CPU, SRAM, and SDRAM. Implemented FSM logic for cache hit/miss management with data coherence, achieving performance gains through extensive simulation and testing on Xilinx ISE.

title: Parallel Computing for Economic Modelling (Capstone Project)
description: Designed and built a parallel computing system with a team for economic modeling and stock correlation analysis, achieving significant performance improvements with Python and TensorFlow. Final implementation uses C++ with OpenMP to enhance scalability across multi-core systems. Achieved a 320% increase in performance with parallelization.
